name: If You Love Me (Let Me Know)

info.album: Olivia Newton-John's Greatest Hits (Deluxe Edition / Remastered 2022)

podcast.body: The title track of her summer 1974 album, this single reached number 5 on the pop chart and number 2 on the country chart, making it Olivia's highest-charting country hit. "The single reached number 5 pop and number 2 country. Olivia's highest charting country hit."

podcast.body: This song was a number 2 country hit and reached number 5 on the pop charts in 1974. Its pop sensibilities led country purists to deem it "not country enough," a criticism also leveled at John Denver. It was nominated for Single of the Year at the 1974 CMAs. "This song, if you love me, let me know, was nominated for a single of the year at the 1974 CMAs."

podcast.body: This song was noted for sounding very similar to "Let Me Be There," which appealed to some listeners but was tiresome for others who felt Olivia Newton-John was overplayed on the radio. It was nominated for the CMA Single of the Year, though it did not win. "If you love me, let me know."
This song was one of a string of crossover hits for Olivia Newton-John that achieved success on both pop and country charts. "In the crossover hits kept on coming, if you love me let me know..."
